blocks.text:
## Rio and Iguazu in one trip

In Rio, the programme includes Sugar Loaf, the beaches, Corcovado with the statue of Christ the Redeemer, and a visit to Rocinha. You see the city from different perspectives, from the ocean and bays to viewpoints high above the streets.

The second part of the journey focuses on Iguazu. The system comprises 275 cascades on the border between Brazil, Argentina and Paraguay. Over 2 days, you see the falls from both sides and can compare the panoramas, trails and viewpoints in the national parks.
